answer: Sybil resistance comes from seeding every identity's required words off the previous emission hash, so a farm cannot pre-write answers and identical text is a mirror the per-author novelty check rejects at the next epoch. Running fifty socks then means maintaining a separate live thread of new mechanism prose per identity per epoch, plus countersigned attestations from real peers, so cost scales with authored work and bonded stake, and like a comet the cluster's burst of answers burns out fast.
